# This gate must run on hosts with no cgo toolchain, including Windows.
# Unlike the race-runtime script, it has no race or cgo prerequisite.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env CC=review-missing-c-compiler
env PATH=$WORK/no-compiler
# Scope the cache to this test: the clean-cache lines below must not
# wipe the shared GOCACHE that parallel script tests use.
[!GOOS:windows] env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
[GOOS:windows] env GOCACHE=$WORK\gocache
cd plain
go list -export -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}} export={{if .Export}}yes{{else}}no{{end}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^example.com/plain export=yes$'
# Drop the build cache before the -compiled check: checkCacheForBuild can
# otherwise serve the compiled file list cached by the -export line above,
# leaving the compiler-free cache-miss path untested.
go clean -cache
go list -e -compiled -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^example.com/plain$'
go list -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}stale={{.Stale}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^stale=(true|false)$'
go list -export -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' fmt
stdout '^fmt$'

cd ../logos
logos list -export -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}} export={{if .Export}}yes{{else}}no{{end}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^example.com/logos export=yes$'
# Same cache hazard as the plain section: evict before the -compiled
# check so the compiler-free cache-miss path is exercised.
logos clean -cache
logos list -e -compiled -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^example.com/logos$'
logos list -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}stale={{.Stale}}{{end}}' .
stdout '^stale=(true|false)$'

-- plain/go.mod --
module example.com/plain

go 1.27

-- plain/plain.go --
package plain

func Sum(a, b int) int { return a + b }

-- logos/go.mod --
module example.com/logos

go 1.27

-- logos/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- logos/logos.lgo --
package logos

func Sum(a, b int) int { return a + b }
